item.text: {"outcome":"pass","rationale":"The candidate correctly distinguishes flags from positional args and supports both claims with the preserved bundle. `command.go:793-828` shows `Traverse` collecting flags (including space-separated values), calling `c.ParseFlags(flags)` when a subcommand is found, and then descending; `command.go:1087-1088` shows this path is conditional on `c.TraverseChildren`.
